SummaryThis scan found 20 issues on 20 elements across 5 pages, and all of them are critical or serious (3 critical, 17 serious). Fix the social icon links in the shared footer first (src/Shell.jsx, footer.site-footer social links, lines 30-32): each one wraps a hidden icon and carries no text or label, so screen readers announce nothing a visitor can act on. That markup is shared, so one fix there clears all 15 of those at once. Next, the low-contrast text on two pages, then the image with no description, the unlabelled form field and the unnamed dropdown.

Groups of open issues the model judged to share one upstream cause, ranked by how many a single fix would clear.

Cluster 1
template src/Shell.jsx footer.site-footer div.social links (lines 30-32) · 15 open issues

Shared footer social markup wraps aria-hidden SVG icons in links carrying no text or aria-label.

Fix

From cluster-1, 1 of 5 groups

Framework

react

Do this

In the shared Footer template's div.social block, give each icon-only anchor a name that matches its destination: aria-label="Benefits Portal on X" on #social-x, aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook" on #social-fb, and aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube" on #social-yt. Leave the decorative circle SVGs as aria-hidden="true" so the label is the only accessible name, and add focusable="false" to each so the SVG itself stays out of tab order. Because Footer is rendered once by Shell, this single edit clears all fifteen nodes across /, /apply, /status, /signin and /status?upload=BP-2026-10882.

Edit

src/Shell.jsx:29–32

Replacement
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-x" id="social-x" aria-label="Benefits Portal on X"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-fb" id="social-fb" aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-yt" id="social-yt" aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
Verify

Re-run axe rules link-name against the 15 listed selectors; all must pass.

Explain

Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer at the end of every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — and hits three stops that announce only "link" with the web address read out, because the icon inside is hidden from them. Fifteen times across the site they must guess whether they are about to leave the benefits application for Facebook, X or YouTube, or tab blindly past.

MANTA detection
Ruleset
axe-coreThe open-source engine every scan runs.
Rule
link-name · Rule reference
How it was tested

axe-core read the page’s HTML and styles. It pressed no key and moved no pointer.

Failed: check focusable-no-name — Element is in tab order and does not have accessible text

Failed: check has-visible-text — Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers

No alternative held either: aria-label, aria-labelledby, non-empty-title.

Also listed under 4.1.2

template src/Shell.jsx footer.site-footer div.social links (lines 30-32) · 15 open issues

Shared footer social markup wraps aria-hidden SVG icons in links carrying no text or aria-label.

Fix

From cluster-1, 1 of 5 groups

Framework

react

Do this

In the shared Footer template's div.social block, give each icon-only anchor a name that matches its destination: aria-label="Benefits Portal on X" on #social-x, aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook" on #social-fb, and aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube" on #social-yt. Leave the decorative circle SVGs as aria-hidden="true" so the label is the only accessible name, and add focusable="false" to each so the SVG itself stays out of tab order. Because Footer is rendered once by Shell, this single edit clears all fifteen nodes across /, /apply, /status, /signin and /status?upload=BP-2026-10882.

Edit

src/Shell.jsx:29–32

Replacement
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-x" id="social-x" aria-label="Benefits Portal on X"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-fb" id="social-fb" aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-yt" id="social-yt" aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
Verify

Re-run axe rules link-name against the 15 listed selectors; all must pass.

Explain

Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer at the end of every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — and hits three stops that announce only "link" with the web address read out, because the icon inside is hidden from them. Fifteen times across the site they must guess whether they are about to leave the benefits application for Facebook, X or YouTube, or tab blindly past.

Cluster 1
template src/Shell.jsx footer.site-footer div.social links (lines 30-32) · 15 open issues

Shared footer social markup wraps aria-hidden SVG icons in links carrying no text or aria-label.

Fix

From cluster-1, 1 of 5 groups

Framework

react

Do this

In the shared Footer template's div.social block, give each icon-only anchor a name that matches its destination: aria-label="Benefits Portal on X" on #social-x, aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook" on #social-fb, and aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube" on #social-yt. Leave the decorative circle SVGs as aria-hidden="true" so the label is the only accessible name, and add focusable="false" to each so the SVG itself stays out of tab order. Because Footer is rendered once by Shell, this single edit clears all fifteen nodes across /, /apply, /status, /signin and /status?upload=BP-2026-10882.

Edit

src/Shell.jsx:29–32

Replacement
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-x" id="social-x" aria-label="Benefits Portal on X"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-fb" id="social-fb" aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-yt" id="social-yt" aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
Verify

Re-run axe rules link-name against the 15 listed selectors; all must pass.

Explain

Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer at the end of every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — and hits three stops that announce only "link" with the web address read out, because the icon inside is hidden from them. Fifteen times across the site they must guess whether they are about to leave the benefits application for Facebook, X or YouTube, or tab blindly past.

Multiple label elements is not widely supported in assistive technologies. Ensure the first label contains all necessary information.
To decide
Multiple label elements is not widely supported in assistive technologies. Ensure the first label contains all necessary information.
Adjudicated
Cannot tell — why

On #dob

The check names two labels, label[for="dob"] and .hint-label, but the payload carries no text for either. Whether the first label alone conveys everything (e.g. the expected date format in the hint) cannot be determined from the markup given.

Advice on an element a person has to judge. It is not a violation, and no count or conformance level reflects it.

4.1.2 Name, Role, Value
Description

aria-expanded={open} in JSX — aria-* and data-* keep their hyphenated names; for becomes htmlFor and class becomes className.
Cluster 1
template src/Shell.jsx footer.site-footer div.social links (lines 30-32) · 15 open issues

Shared footer social markup wraps aria-hidden SVG icons in links carrying no text or aria-label.

Fix

From cluster-1, 1 of 5 groups

Framework

react

Do this

In the shared Footer template's div.social block, give each icon-only anchor a name that matches its destination: aria-label="Benefits Portal on X" on #social-x, aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook" on #social-fb, and aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube" on #social-yt. Leave the decorative circle SVGs as aria-hidden="true" so the label is the only accessible name, and add focusable="false" to each so the SVG itself stays out of tab order. Because Footer is rendered once by Shell, this single edit clears all fifteen nodes across /, /apply, /status, /signin and /status?upload=BP-2026-10882.

Edit

src/Shell.jsx:29–32

Replacement
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-x" id="social-x" aria-label="Benefits Portal on X"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-fb" id="social-fb" aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-yt" id="social-yt" aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
Verify

Re-run axe rules link-name against the 15 listed selectors; all must pass.

Explain

Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer at the end of every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — and hits three stops that announce only "link" with the web address read out, because the icon inside is hidden from them. Fifteen times across the site they must guess whether they are about to leave the benefits application for Facebook, X or YouTube, or tab blindly past.

MANTA detection
Ruleset
axe-coreThe open-source engine every scan runs.
Rule
link-name · Rule reference
How it was tested

axe-core read the page’s HTML and styles. It pressed no key and moved no pointer.

Failed: check focusable-no-name — Element is in tab order and does not have accessible text

Failed: check has-visible-text — Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers

No alternative held either: aria-label, aria-labelledby, non-empty-title.

Also listed under 2.4.4

Cluster 1
template src/Shell.jsx footer.site-footer div.social links (lines 30-32) · 15 open issues

Shared footer social markup wraps aria-hidden SVG icons in links carrying no text or aria-label.

Fix

From cluster-1, 1 of 5 groups

Framework

react

Do this

In the shared Footer template's div.social block, give each icon-only anchor a name that matches its destination: aria-label="Benefits Portal on X" on #social-x, aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook" on #social-fb, and aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube" on #social-yt. Leave the decorative circle SVGs as aria-hidden="true" so the label is the only accessible name, and add focusable="false" to each so the SVG itself stays out of tab order. Because Footer is rendered once by Shell, this single edit clears all fifteen nodes across /, /apply, /status, /signin and /status?upload=BP-2026-10882.

Edit

src/Shell.jsx:29–32

Replacement
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-x" id="social-x" aria-label="Benefits Portal on X"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-fb" id="social-fb" aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-yt" id="social-yt" aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
Verify

Re-run axe rules link-name against the 15 listed selectors; all must pass.

Explain

Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer at the end of every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — and hits three stops that announce only "link" with the web address read out, because the icon inside is hidden from them. Fifteen times across the site they must guess whether they are about to leave the benefits application for Facebook, X or YouTube, or tab blindly past.

Cluster 1
template src/Shell.jsx footer.site-footer div.social links (lines 30-32) · 15 open issues

Shared footer social markup wraps aria-hidden SVG icons in links carrying no text or aria-label.

Fix

From cluster-1, 1 of 5 groups

Framework

react

Do this

In the shared Footer template's div.social block, give each icon-only anchor a name that matches its destination: aria-label="Benefits Portal on X" on #social-x, aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook" on #social-fb, and aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube" on #social-yt. Leave the decorative circle SVGs as aria-hidden="true" so the label is the only accessible name, and add focusable="false" to each so the SVG itself stays out of tab order. Because Footer is rendered once by Shell, this single edit clears all fifteen nodes across /, /apply, /status, /signin and /status?upload=BP-2026-10882.

Edit

src/Shell.jsx:29–32

Replacement
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-x" id="social-x" aria-label="Benefits Portal on X"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-fb" id="social-fb" aria-label="Benefits Portal on Facebook"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
        <a href="https://example.com/benefits-yt" id="social-yt" aria-label="Benefits Portal on YouTube"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="currentColor"/></svg></a>
Verify

Re-run axe rules link-name against the 15 listed selectors; all must pass.

Explain

Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer at the end of every page — home, apply, sign-in, status — and hits three stops that announce only "link" with the web address read out, because the icon inside is hidden from them. Fifteen times across the site they must guess whether they are about to leave the benefits application for Facebook, X or YouTube, or tab blindly past.
